scenes.stage_direction: Private memories interrupt the investigation. David listens without competing with either man from Amara's past.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: They admit sending the photograph to Victor.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: A photograph of me laughing became permission for him to visit my gate.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Their account gives us a date for when he learned about us.

metadata.evidence_summary: A household observer reported Amara and David to Victor.
